name: R'lyeh Wakes
description: Cosmic horror for headphones, after the mythos of the Great Old Ones: the sunken city of R'lyeh humming from the centre of your head out into the stone, a call hidden in the noise of the deep that only both ears together can hear, a shoggoth's eyes opening all around you, Father Dagon circling beneath you, a colour out of space that pulls the ears apart in cents, cultists chanting in a ring around a swamp fire, non-Euclidean angles, the Necronomicon read aloud over your shoulder, dead Cthulhu dreaming over a slow delta drone and, once, the night the stars are right. The deepest things stay in the centre while the horrors use the space around you. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low, lights off if you dare.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: R'lyeh Rising
sketches.description: Headphones on: the sunken city far beneath the Pacific. The sea is muffled far above you, the city's hum steps from the centre of your head out into the stone, cyclopean masonry creaks from impossible angles and a drowned choir sings through the walls. On speakers the 180-degree bars of the hum nearly vanish.

sketches.name: The Call
sketches.description: The noise of the deep is white noise, but between the ears it carries a chant (Huggins pitch). Each ear alone hears only hiss; only both together hear the call. A quiet hum gives the first bar every four bars so you know what to listen for, while whispers circle your head. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: Shoggoth
sketches.description: Headphones on: eyes open and close at random places all over the dark around your head, the cry of tekeli-li circles you, and the shapeless bass sends its lows to one ear and its highs to the other. Only the kick stays in the middle.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// Eyes opening all over its body: wet pops at random places around your head, near and far
eyes: s("click*16?0.5").speed(rand.range(.3, 1.2))
  .azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(rand.range(-40, 40)).distance(rand.range(.7, 3))
  .seed("eyes").gain(.2)

// Tekeli-li! The cry circles you once every four bars
cry: note("<[e5 e5 g5 e5] ~ [f5 f5 a5 f5] ~>").s("voice").syl("te ke li li").voicetype("soprano")
  .fry(.4).jitter(.6).mono(1).vglide(.05).release(.3)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(4)).distance(2).posglide(.3).gain(.18)

// Its mass: a bass folded over on itself, the lows in one ear and the highs in the other
mass: note("<e1 e1 f1 e1>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").s("sawtooth")
  .curve("fold").drive(sine.range(6, 20).slow(4)).earsplit("bands").splitfreq(400)
  .lpf(1500).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.1).gain(.3)

// Slime: unrelated brown noise in each ear, oozing all around
slime: s("brown").slow(4).icorr(.1).lpf(sine.range(150, 500).slow(8)).gain(.14)

// The kick: the one thing still in the middle of your head
kick: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").shape(.3).gain(.6)

sketches.name: Father Dagon
sketches.description: Headphones on: off the reef at Innsmouth, in the black water. A 2 Hz binaural drone hums in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning, Father Dagon circles slowly beneath you, the Deep Ones' hum rolls inside your head and bubbles drift past your ears.

sketches.name: The Colour Out of Space
sketches.description: A meteor in the well: bells whose partials are shifted off any key strike from random places around you, a pad's ears drift apart in cents until it sickens into a wide, seasick blight, the well hums ring-modulated underneath and the insects on the farm fall silent one by one.

sketches.name: Cultists in the Marsh
sketches.description: Headphones on: a bonfire in a Louisiana swamp, and the cultists chanting in a ring around you, one voice ahead, one on each side and one behind, each a little later than the last. Drums hop from ear to ear, frogs croak in the reeds and a quiet 6 Hz binaural beat in the theta range hums under it all. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Non-Euclidean Geometry
sketches.description: Angles that are wrong: one figure plays at three speeds from random places around you and they meet every eight bars, the hats are spread evenly around your head by the van der Corput sequence, a second drummer on your right slips a sixteenth each bar and the drone leans from ear to ear on tiny delays, as if the room were tilting.

sketches.name: The Necronomicon
sketches.description: Late at night in the restricted stacks at Miskatonic: nothing is panned, yet the organ's brightness creeps slowly from ear to ear, as each ear has its own low-pass sweeping the other way. A candle burns on your left, a clock ticks on your right, rain falls beyond the leaded windows and someone reads aloud just behind your shoulder.

sketches.name: Dead Cthulhu Dreaming
sketches.description: Headphones on: in his house at R'lyeh dead Cthulhu waits dreaming. A 2 Hz binaural drone hums in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning, a drowned choir breathes through stone and water, his dreams circle slowly beneath you and the weight of the ocean presses in, different in each ear.

sketches.name: The Stars Are Right
sketches.description: Listen through once from the start. For four bars the cultists chant and the toms speed up while the noise in your ears spreads from a point into a wash; on bar five Cthulhu wakes and roars, dead centre. Then the city rises from below you, the stars wheel high overhead and a 2 Hz delta drone, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning, carries the new aeon.
sketches.source:
setcpm(64/4)

// Bars 1-4: icorr 1 is the same noise in both ears, a point; near 0 it is unrelated noise in each, a wash
riser: s("pink").icorr("<1 .7 .4 .1>").hpf(saw.range(200, 4000).slow(4))
  .gain("<.03 .06 .09 .13>").exit(4)

// The cultists chant, faster drums under them
chant: note("<[d3 d3 f3 d3] [d3 d3 g3 f3] [eb3 eb3 g3 eb3] [d3 f3 ab3 g3]>").s("choir")
  .syl("<[i_a i_a ka thu] [i_a i_a ka thu] [fa tag loo ah] [fa tag loo ah]>")
  .attack(.05).release(.4).space("hall").exit(4).gain(.24)
toms: s("<lt*4 lt*8 lt*16 lt*16>").speed(.7).lpf(900).gain(saw.range(.2, .5)).exit(4)

// Bar 5: he wakes. An impact, and the roar right in front of your face
impact: s("[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~").speed(.3).lpf(400).room(.9).size(.95).enter(4).exit(5).gain(.8)
roar: note("[c2@2 g2@3 db2@3]").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(25).mono(1).glide(.3)
  .vowel("ah").curve("tube").drive(14).lpf(1200).attack(.1).sustain(.8).release(2)
  .distance(1).enter(4).exit(6).gain(.22)

// The city rises from below you over four bars, then fades
city: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,c4] [db3,f3,ab3,c4] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [g2,b2,d3,g3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(1400).attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1.5)
  .elevation(saw.range(-60, 40).slow(4)).distance(4).posglide(.5).room(.6)
  .enter(5).gain(.16).fadeout(4, 12)

// The stars wheel high overhead
stars: n(irand(8).segment(8)).scale("C:phrygian").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.7).seed("stars")
  .s("sine").decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.5)
  .azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(60).distance(4).enter(6).gain(.08)

// The new aeon: a 2 Hz binaural drone, below the 3-30 Hz warning range
aeon: note("[c2,g2]").slow(4).s("sine").binaural(2).attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).enter(8).gain(.2)
